finalText:
Order O-3001 is fully refunded, but the warehouse side is only partly done. The two shipped items aren't restocked yet, and I didn't restock the cancelled hubs.

- **L3 (2 × USB-C Hub, never shipped):** I cancelled the line and refunded the $138.00 she paid back to her card (RF-1). I did not restock the hubs. The reviewer blocked it because the line looks backordered: it never shipped in the two-plus months after L1 and L2 went out. Also, no stock movement was ever recorded against this order. A backordered line has no stock set aside, so restocking would have added units that don't exist. If the warehouse confirms stock was actually allocated to it, 2 units of P-HUB should go back in.
- **L1 (Laptop Dock) and L2 (Monitor):** Both shipped on 2026-05-04, which is more than 30 days ago. Under the return policy, that means the refund has to be store credit, not card. I recorded a $548.00 store-credit refund on the order (RF-2) and added the same $548.00 to her balance, which went from $5.00 to $553.00.
- **Order status:** The order now shows as returned, with $686.00 of $686.00 refunded.
- **Warehouse:** I haven't restocked the dock or the monitor. Returned goods only go back into stock once the warehouse receives them. Once they arrive, someone needs to restock 1 × P-DOC and 1 × P-MON.
